title: Job search automation with you in control | SearchBreaker
description: Automate repetitive job-search work while keeping decisions visible and under your control. Learn the workflow, its controls and what you can review before applying.

blocks.headline: Job search automation with you in control
blocks.lead: SearchBreaker takes over the repeated work of searching, comparing and preparing. You choose the roles, review what it prepared and decide what happens next.

blocks.heading: What the workflow can automate
blocks.lead: Four stages of the search can run in the background. Each stage shows what is available today.

steps.title: Discover jobs
steps.text: Collect new openings that fit your target roles from the sources you choose.

steps.title: Evaluate fit
steps.text: Compare each job’s requirements with the experience you confirmed.

steps.title: Prepare materials
steps.text: Draft a tailored resume and answers from verified facts, ready for your review.

steps.title: Track progress
steps.text: Keep every application, resume version and next step in one pipeline.

blocks.heading: Where you review and decide
blocks.lead: Automation prepares. You approve. These are the points where the workflow stops and waits for you.

points.title: Approve which jobs to pursue
points.text: New openings wait in a review queue. Save the ones you want and skip the rest.

points.title: Review every prepared material
points.text: Tailored resumes and answers are drafts until you accept them.

points.title: Decide when to submit
points.text: Nothing is sent to an employer without an explicit action from you.

points.title: Pause or stop at any time
points.text: Pause the search or skip a job without losing your profile or your history.

blocks.heading: Automation versus auto apply
blocks.lead: Automation covers the whole search. Auto apply is one narrower step inside it. Here is who does what.

blocks.heading: Set up your search
blocks.lead: You describe the search once. Every stage uses the same settings.

items.title: Roles and level
items.text: Choose the titles you want and the seniority you are aiming for.

items.title: Location and work mode
items.text: Set where you can work and whether remote, hybrid or on-site fits.

items.title: Preferences
items.text: Add the industries, company types and conditions that matter to you.

items.title: Sources
items.text: Choose where openings come from. Only verified sources are listed.

faqs.a: No. Automation here means less repeated work, not more volume for its own sake. Openings wait for your approval, and nothing is sent without an action from you.
Yes. You can skip any opening, pause the search at any time and restart it later. Your profile and history stay as they are.

faqs.q: Does it work on every job site?
faqs.a: Not every site. Coverage is published only for sources that have been tested, with the date of the last check. Until a source is verified, it is not listed.

faqs.q: Is job search automation available now?
faqs.a: It is in private testing. Join the waitlist to get an invite when the stages you need are ready.
